nodes.name: ReadPaymentRequest
nodes.role: read the payment request the user describes, including the caller's claimed shortfall and the payee named in the call

nodes.name: LookUpOriginalPurchase
nodes.role: find the user's original iPhone purchase record and the amount actually paid

nodes.name: VerifyWithApple
nodes.role: confirm through Apple's official support channel, not the number that called, whether any VAT shortfall exists and how much is owed

nodes.name: ComputeVerifiedAmount
nodes.role: calculate the amount owed from the verified shortfall, if one was confirmed

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the verified payee and amount and ask for explicit approval before any money moves

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: pay the approved amount to the verified payee

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: tell the user whether the payment was made, or why it was not
